newsitem.title: USA: Halsey to sell certain assets for $15 mln.
newsitem.headline: Halsey to sell certain assets for $15 mln.

text.p: Halsey Drug Co Inc said Friday it has a non-binding agreement with a generic drug maker to sell two Halsey units in Indiana and other assets for $15 million.

The transaction is part of a broader deal involving a marketing alliance between the two and a partial tender offer by the generic drug maker, which was not identified, for about 19 percent of Halsey's outstanding shares.

Halsey said the asset sale also calls for Halsey to repay $3 million in outstanding promissory notes issued in favor of the purchaser. Included in the transfer of the Indiana properties is a manufacturing factility, it said.
Under the proposed marketing alliance, the generic drug maker would will acquire marketing and distribution rights to certain Halsey products, Halsey said.

If the two companies reach final agreement on the asset sale and maketing alliance, Halsey said the generic drug maker will execute a partial tender offer for 2.8 million shares -- about 19 percent -- of Halsey common stock at $6 per share.
Friday's announcement came about three weeks after Halsey reported first quarter losses of more than $3.1 million, or $0.24 per share.
